support_note: All three completed single-axis consumers remain below the locked floor across 8 total realized partitions, so additional corpus growth would be required before stronger axis-level signal statements become available.

The three completed consumers show that single-axis readouts are structurally consumable, but they do not expose cross-axis interactions, temporal trends, or rare-segment effects, which may motivate a different bounded consumer family later.
Repo truth contains one committed SSS instance only, so the current consumer set cannot describe multi-instance trend or cadence behavior without additional committed SSS windows.

The advisory-source consumer is an SSS-0001 readout rather than a first-class source-only summary instance, so any future source-only summary shape would require a different SSS schema or derivation contract.
